consequence.statement: Remote clusters installed with the istiod-remote chart must change how they are installed: the istiod-remote chart has been merged into the istio-discovery chart, so they now install istio/istiod with profile=remote, and they also need the istio-base chart.
consequence.remediation: Install remote clusters with `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote` instead of the istiod-remote chart, and install the istio-base chart in both local and remote clusters.

assertion.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the istiod-remote Helm chart is merged into the regular istio-discovery (istiod) chart. Clusters that use a remote control plane are now installed with `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote` instead of `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote`, and they also need the istio-base chart.
